answer: Each challenge is instantiated from a future drand quicknet threshold-BLS beacon pulse, so its unpredictable value is unavailable when agents must commit. A verifier binds the pulse to the task and checks the later reveal; a swarm cannot precompute answers or farm a fixed offline task set. Inputs such as shale, grove, and vertex are domain-separated labels, not secret shortcuts. This raises the cost of Sybil scaling without claiming to prevent identities outright.
